plan.title: security(lifecycle): refuse symlink write targets for events.jsonl (#2761)

narratives.Description: Make lifecycle:event refuse symlink or otherwise unsafe write targets for .deft-cache/events.jsonl. Prevent project-controlled symlinks from redirecting appends outside the repository under the operator identity.
narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#2761

## What to build

Make `task lifecycle:event` refuse symlink (or otherwise unsafe) write targets for `.deft-cache/events.jsonl` so a project-controlled symlink cannot redirect appends outside the repository under the operator identity.

Thread an explicit `projectRoot` from `runLifecycleEvent` through the event writer. Couple validation with the opened file (`assertWriteTargetSafe` + `O_NOFOLLOW` where supported) to avoid a TOCTOU gap.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Default project-owned log calls `assertWriteTargetSafe(projectRoot, target)` before directory creation/write
- [ ] Escaping parent directories, final-target symlinks, and dangling symlinks are refused with an actionable nonzero CLI result
- [ ] Explicit `--log` / `DEFT_EVENT_LOG` paths may be outside `projectRoot` but still refuse symlink following
- [ ] Writes go through an opened descriptor closed in `finally`
- [ ] Regression tests cover symlink-to-victim, parent-dir symlink, dangling symlink, unchanged victim files after refusal, and normal default/explicit-log append behavior
- [ ] `task check` passes

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

None — independent of Story A; recommended merge after A only for review-surface sizing
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Thread projectRoot through the lifecycle events module packages/core/src/lifecycle/events.ts and call assertWriteTargetSafe before append. 2) Add fixture tests in packages/core/src/lifecycle/events.test.ts that verify symlink targets are rejected and victim files are unchanged.
narratives.UserStory: As a deft operator, I want lifecycle event appends to refuse symlink write targets, so that a project cannot redirect operator-identity writes outside the repo.
